import sys

def main():
    s = sys.stdin.read().split()[0]  # read first token
    at_used = False
    i = 0
    n = len(s)
    while i < n:
        remaining = n - i
        if i == 0:
            print(s[i], end='')
            i += 1
        elif remaining >= 3 and s[i:i+3] == "dot" and remaining != 3:
            print('.', end='')
            i += 3
        elif not at_used and remaining >= 2 and s[i:i+2] == "at" and remaining != 2:
            print('@', end='')
            at_used = True
            i += 2
        else:
            print(s[i], end='')
            i += 1

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
